<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_BudgetAllocation" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/budget-allocation">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_BudgetAllocation" name="Departmental Budget Allocation" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_BudgetProcess" name="Budget planning period begins"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OutlineObjectives" name="Outline departmental objectives"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DraftPlan" name="Draft plan with cost estimates and budget justifications"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_StrategicAlignmentReview" name="Review plan in strategic alignment meeting"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FinanceReview" name="Perform detailed finance feasibility review"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdjustmentsRequired" name="Adjustments required?" default="Flow_NoAdjustments"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DocumentAdjustment" name="Document adjustment"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ApproveAdjustment" name="Approve adjustment by stakeholders"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ApproveFinalBudget" name="Approve final budget version"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AllocateBudget" name="Allocate budget to department"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DistributeBudget" name="Distribute budget and begin plan implementation"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ImplementationStarted" name="Plan implementation begins"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToObjectives" sourceRef="StartEvent_BudgetProcess" targetRef="Task_OutlineObjectives"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ObjectivesToDraft" sourceRef="Task_OutlineObjectives" targetRef="Task_DraftPlan"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DraftToStrategic" sourceRef="Task_DraftPlan" targetRef="Task_StrategicAlignmentReview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StrategicToFinance" sourceRef="Task_StrategicAlignmentReview" targetRef="Task_FinanceReview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FinanceToGateway" sourceRef="Task_FinanceReview" targetRef="Gateway_AdjustmentsRequired"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdjustmentsYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_AdjustmentsRequired" targetRef="Task_DocumentAdjustment">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${adjustmentsRequired}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoAdjustments" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_AdjustmentsRequired" targetRef="Task_ApproveFinalBudget"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DocumentToApprove" sourceRef="Task_DocumentAdjustment" targetRef="Task_ApproveAdjustment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ApproveAdjustmentToFinance" sourceRef="Task_ApproveAdjustment" targetRef="Task_FinanceReview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FinalApprovalToAllocate" sourceRef="Task_ApproveFinalBudget" targetRef="Task_AllocateBudget"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AllocateToDistribute" sourceRef="Task_AllocateBudget" targetRef="Task_DistributeBudget"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DistributeToEnd" sourceRef="Task_DistributeBudget" targetRef="EndEvent_ImplementationStarted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
